title: Cyrus Cylinder
summary: A clay cylinder recording Cyrus's policy after the conquest of Babylon.
historical_context: An important witness to Persian imperial ideology and the broader restoration context.
ancient_near_east_context: The item belongs to the broader imperial, cultic, and urban world of the ancient Near East and the biblical periods reflected in the dataset.
literary_context: Frequently compared with the Persian return tradition in Ezra.
covenantal_significance: Cyrus Cylinder helps anchor biblical claims in historical reality while reminding readers that archaeology supports rather than replaces interpretation.
interpretive_notes: The cylinder is genuine, but it is not a direct copy of the biblical decree.
Use the item as context for the biblical text, not as a shortcut around it.
